P6 manual XML/XER exchange remains proposed, asymmetric by baseline support; current full-fidelity P&Pmis P6 export is not asserted.

final_boundary: Strategic signoff remains STRATEGIC_MACROPROCESS_TECHNICALLY_READY_UAT_SIGNOFF_PENDING. This is design evidence, not business acceptance. Stop before O1 implementation.
